newsitem.title: USA: First Financial to buy Investors Savings.
newsitem.headline: First Financial to buy Investors Savings.

text.p: First Financial Holdings Inc said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire privately-held Investors Savings Bank of South Carolina, paying $45 per share in common stock for all shares of Investors Savings Bank.
The company said the total value of the acquisition is about $11.7 million.
The acquisition, which has been approved by the boards of directors of each company, is expected to close in October, said First Financial.
Founded in 1984, Investors Savings Bank has approximately $63.2 million in total assets and operates two branches in Florence, South Carolina.

First Financial is the multiple thrift holding company for First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Charleston and Peoples Federal Savings and Loan Association of Conway. The two associations operate a total of 33 offices.
